# Sea escape reef tiles

Generated with the built-in image_gen tool. Reference: `../sea-water-tile-v1.png` (palette and pixel style). Original RGBA PNGs are preserved; Phaser frames remove transparent padding at display time.

Files: `reef-low-v1.png`, `reef-ridge-v1.png`.

## low

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG ocean reef obstacle tile for PETOA 16-bit JRPG, overlaid on the attached bright cobalt-blue ocean tile (reference is palette/pixel STYLE only; do NOT copy it as background). Slight top-down three-quarter view. Crisp chunky authentic pixel art, roughly 64x40 logical pixels enlarged as square clusters. Natural wet blue-gray volcanic stone, dark navy submerged edges, restrained warm gray top highlights. A few BROKEN irregular white/cyan foam flecks hug the actual rocks and crevices, subtle cobalt blue at waterline. Genuine transparent alpha background everywhere else. No sand, no soil, no vegetation, no grass, no circular ring, no ellipse, no halo, no round island base, no opaque rectangle of water, no broad surrounding water patch, no text. Entire object uncropped and tight centered composition, 5 percent transparent padding. Draw one asymmetric low reef: two squat weathered rock slabs and a smaller half-submerged pointed stone, low and wide irregular outline, mostly submerged rather than a tall mountain. Sparse surf on one side only. Width about 1.7 times height.
